questions.question: Because there was so much sexual immorality, what did Paul tell the Corinthians each man and each woman should have?

answers.text: An elder to watch over them

questions.question: Paul gave married people a command from the Lord. What did it say about a wife?

answers.text: She must not separate from her husband
She must pray for her husband daily
She must keep her husband's customs

questions.question: What did Paul tell a believer whose unbelieving husband or wife was willing to keep living with them?

answers.text: Wait for them to believe first
Bring the matter to the elders

questions.question: What did Paul tell someone who was a slave when God called him?

answers.text: Don't let it concern you but take freedom if you can
Run away from your master as soon as you can
Stay a slave even if you're offered your freedom
